token.title: 🔑 Tokeni ya GitHub
token.intro: GitHub imayankha mapempho 60 pa ola ku adilesi yomwe situmiza tokeni. Mtengo wonse wa ma-fork umadya pafupifupi 32, choncho ulendo wachiwiri umatha. Tokeni imakweza malire kufika 5000 pa ola.
token.step1: Tsegulani Settings, Developer settings, Personal access tokens, Fine-grained tokens, kenako Generate new token.
token.step2: Resource owner: akaunti yanu. Expiration: tsiku lililonse, mtengo sufuna chokhalitsa.
token.step4: Musakhudze chilolezo chilichonse. Meta ya nkhokwe za anthu onse sifuna chilichonse mwa izo.
token.step5: Pangani, kenako koperani mtengo wa {token}. GitHub imauonetsa kamodzi kokha.
token.classic: Tokeni yakale imagwiranso ntchito: pangani imodzi yopanda gawo losankhidwa. Gawo lopanda kanthu limawerengabe deta ya anthu onse pa liwiro lotsimikizika.
token.stays: Imakhala mu msakatuli uwu pansi pa kiyi {key} ndipo imapita ku {host} kokha. Siilembedwa mu bala la adilesi, choncho ulalo umene mugawana umanyamula chiwonetsero osati chiphaso. Batani lomwe lili pansi pa bokosi limaifufutanso pamodzi ndi cache.
token.persistHow: Ikani tokeni mu fayilo {env} ya seva yomwe imasunga tsamba ili, pafupi ndi {port}:
token.proxy: ndipo yambitsani ndi {make}. Kenako chidebe chimalemba kachidutswa ka nginx komwe kamaphatikiza mutu wa {header} ku proxy ya {path}, choncho msakatuli umaitana komwe unachokera ndipo sulandira tokeni. Bokosi ili limasowa ndipo alendo onse amagawana bajeti imodzi ya 5000 pa ola.
fork.refused404: Palibe mizere ya nthambi: {message}. 404 apa ndi nthambi yomwe palibe kapena njira yomwe proxy ya seva sinyamula; netiweki ya ma-fork pamwambapa ndi yathunthu mulimonse.
fork.refusedExhausted: GitHub yatha mapempho a ola ili, choncho mizere ya nthambi sinathe kujambulidwa. Netiweki ya ma-fork pamwambapa ndi yathunthu. Onjezani tokeni pa gulu la sefa, kapena zimitsani mizere ya nthambi pa gulu la kapangidwe kuti mugwiritse ntchito bajeti pa netiweki yokha.
fork.refusedOther: GitHub yayankha {status} pa mbiri ya ma-commit, choncho mizere ya nthambi sinathe kujambulidwa. Netiweki ya ma-fork pamwambapa ndi yathunthu.
fork.tagsOrphaned: Tagi ilibe tsiku, choncho yotsala iliyonse ingafune pempho lomwe gawo lotsala la ola silinagwiritsidwe ntchito.
fork.axisZoomed: {axis}, zenera la ma-commit ndi ma-tagi otengedwa. Mizere ya ma-fork yakale kuposa pamenepo imakanikizidwa ku mbali ya kumanzere.
fork.axisWhole: {axis}. Tsegulani nkhokwe kuti mujambule njira zake za ma-commit ndi kuphatikiza; kenako mzere umachepera ku mbiri imeneyo.

forks.exhausted: GitHub yatha mapempho a ola ili. Onjezani tokeni pa gulu la sefa kuti mukweze malire kuchoka pa 60 kufika 5000, kapena bwererani ola likasintha.

bond.help: Mzere kupita ku mzati pamwamba, mzati kupita ku mzere pansi. Mgwirizano wa 0 ndi tsamba, 1 ndi wotsutsana nawo. Kuyendetsa cholozera kumadutsa awiriwo mu chikasu, kudina kumawatseka mu wofiirira mpaka kudina kotsatira. Kuwerenga kokha; yendetsani infinito bond CLI kuti musinthe.
